company.shortDescription: Rabbit is a clean-tech transportation company.
company.description: Rabbit is a micro-mobility sharing platform for short-distance transportation using environmentally friendly vehicles. The company's products include standing electric scooters and electric bikes. The company also offers a QR code on the scooter’s handlebar to unlock it, a kickstand, a kick-start, and the ability to press the accelerator features.
